morphology.pattern_note: is_root 和 root_word 沿用输入标记，不代表已确认存在该马来语词根。不得拆出马来语 di- 前缀；若原文确为 didn't，相关英语结构才是 did + n't。

senses.zh_definition: 【文本片段名称】待核实的字母串 didn；现有资料不足以赋予其独立的马来语词义。
senses.en_definition: An unresolved text fragment, here mentioned as a string rather than assigned an independent Malay meaning.
senses.ms_definition: Rentetan huruf yang belum dikenal pasti sebagai perkataan bahasa Melayu berdasarkan maklumat yang tersedia.
senses.nuances: noun 仅表示本条把该字母串作为讨论对象，不是确认它具有名词词义。didn 可能来自 didn't 的截断或文本切分，但缺少上下文，不能直接还原。Cambridge 收录的是 didn't，即 did not 的缩略形式，并不据此确认 didn。[Cambridge：didn't](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/didn-t)。以下为文本讨论表达，不是已确立的词汇搭配。

dual_scenarios.context: 编辑核查 / 语料整理；讨论原始片段
dual_scenarios.ms: Bentuk 'didn' perlu disemak berdasarkan ayat asal sebelum sebarang pembetulan dibuat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在作出任何修改之前，需要根据原句核查 didn 这一形式。
dual_scenarios.en: The form 'didn' needs to be checked against the original sentence before any correction is made.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 同事核对文字；讨论原始片段
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kat sini tertulis 'didn' je. Nak semak ayat asal dulu?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Di sini hanya tertulis 'didn'. Mahukah kita menyemak ayat asal terlebih dahulu?
dual_scenarios.zh: 这里就写着 didn。先看看原句？
dual_scenarios.en: It only says 'didn' here. Shall we check the original sentence first?
spoken_features: kat sini 对应 di sini
nak 对应 hendak，并在此构成建议
didn 为被引用的文本片段，不是句中正常使用的马来语词

etymology.historical_story: No independent word history can responsibly be assigned to this fragment. A possible connection is English didn't, the contraction of did not, but that identification remains conditional. An apostrophe or a missing final letter can change what a dictionary should record, so the surrounding sentence is essential evidence. [Cambridge: didn't](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/didn-t)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 didn，先找原句和缺失字符；只有确认原文是 didn't，才联想到 did not。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 核对他人文字时，可说 Boleh kita semak ayat asal?，意为我们能核对一下原句吗，避免未经核实就断言对方拼错。
